strings.en: The best defense is a good offense... I'm striking first!
Let the flow of time lend Excellence/　its power once more...!
I'm counting on you, Excellence Gunstriker!
I'll show you what the Gunstriker Frame can do!
That trick won't work on an Excellence/　with a Time Flow Engine!
Jua-Mu, I'll show you/　what the Gunstriker Frame can do!
I'll hold that unit back/　with the Excellence Gunstriker!
I won't let you lay a hand on Touya and the others!
The Gunstriker will smash that shield!
Karo-Ran!/　Your Larseilam won't work on me!
So that's Gu-Landon's trump card.../　But I won't let you use Larseilam!
Gu-Landon, accept the possibility/　that Touya and the others represent!
Whatever your true identity or goals may be...!
You're the ones who started this!
Alien mercenaries, huh... I'd better be careful.
I'm pretty confident in my own firepower too!
I don't have time to deal with you!
I have to get to Rabulpaila as soon as possible...!
Its mobility is nothing to scoff at...!
If you care about Gadisword's future,/　let us through!
Reggiane! I don't have time for you!
I'll take on the Siebe Drive/　with the Time Flow Engine!
Like I'd ever acknowledge your research!
Your looks won't fool me, Debudedabide!
If nobody's aboard, I won't hold back!
I'll handle monster extermination jobs just fine!
Don't think you can do as you please in this world,/　Skull Knight!
I'll smash your bones and armor alike!
It's a broken machine too.../　No, maybe it was meant to be that way from the start!
XN-L,/　you have no right to stop our time!
No matter how many times you attack us!
A Rest Rail! I'll take it down!
I need to watch out for the Geios series...!
I can even trade fire with a battle carrier!
A Thick Cylinder! Here I come!
Big Shoulder... I'll take it down!
White Horn locked! Here I come!
We've got data on that unit!
Target locked: Gasbra. Here I come!
No matter how many show up, I'll beat them!
Kaana type or not, I'll wipe you out!
Combining won't make you a match for the Gunstriker!
No matter how big the Lamaris get!
I have to clean up all the Lamaris here...!
I can't let Dark Brain be revived!/　Out of my way!
I won't let you get away!
Some example I'm setting as company president...!
I can't lose the Time Flow Engine here!
I can still go! As long as I can attack!
As long as the Time Turbine is spinning, I can do this!
If it weren't for this frame,/　I'd have been shot down...!
Ugh!/　Is the Tesla Drive... okay?!
Jua-Mu, I won't let you go any further!
That guy's stronger than a Knight...!
Reggiane, I've got no intention of entertaining you!
Believe...! The Time Flow Engine/　won't lose to the Siebe Drive!
I can't let it keep laughing at me...!
Getting exterminated by a dragon? No way!
I won't let it end with Skull Knight pushing me back!
Like I'd despair over something like this!
Ugh... I have to move faster,/　or I can't stand up to the Raftclans...!
I can't lose this frame/　in the fight against the Fury!
I knew they'd come after the Excellence,/　and yet...!
Damn, it handles almost the same/　as the Striker, and still...!
If only I had a shield... No time to say that!
To slip up at a moment like this...!
I wasn't counting on the armor, but...!
Like I'd stop in a place like this!
The Gunstriker can still take it!
No way I'm getting overpowered by Jua-Mu!
I won't be crushed by that guy's obsession!
An attack like this, with that way of talking...!
If I get bogged down with Reggiane here...!
Ngh! I can't let him use/　the Cross Gate any more...!
That Crystal Dragoon is aiming at me so calmly...!
This fight isn't over yet, Skull Knight!
XN-L!/　The Excellence and I can still fight!
Damn, I can't hold back the Raftclans!
I can't let something like that possess me!
That Lamaris is getting more active!
Ngh! So what if you got bigger!
Combining sure made its attacks heavy...!
Just like it looks,/　this is no ordinary Lamaris...!
That power... It's more than the data said!
If I take it on a sturdy spot, I can limit the damage!
I don't have a shield, but this much is fine!
The Striker and Gunner are both sturdy frames.
I need to rethink my evasion patterns...!
Is that all the Emperor Unit's got?!
Is that guy sizing me up or something...?!
I've got no intention of shedding blood!
With this, I can hold my own against the Floraga!
Your magic's not so great after all!
Is that all you've got, XN-L?!
Even though we have their data...!
I wasn't underestimating/　the Geios Series, but...!
Like I'd let some ghost get me!
Damn Ares Geist, it's faster than before...!
I can't shake off the Lamaris...!
The Kaana Type's got its teeth in me...!
It can hit me, at that size?!
I can't let this frame get wrecked!
I won't fall for that, Iradoya!
Don't mess with the Excellence, Gomoudokka!
You don't know when to quit, Reggiane!
With all the data we have, it's easy to deal with!
As long as I know their patterns,/　even the Geios Series is no problem!
Like I'd lose to a monster!
All that swelling up made you sluggish!
I'll keep up even with the Raftclans!
Like I'd lose to the Lamaris!
Even if it's a Kaana type!
I'll keep up even with the Ida types!
Hard to believe this was a rush job.
It's lighter on its feet than it looks!
All that effort for nothing, Skull Knight!
Damn, I've got no usable weapons...!
Damn, I lost sight of them!
I'll back you up with the Excellence!
If we aim for the same spot!
Fiona, leave the rest to me!
Same frame, so teaming up is easy!
Touya, leave the rest to me!
Arado, leave the rest to me!
Major Sänger, I'll back you up!
Major Gilliam, I'm going in too!
If I follow the Lieutenant's lead.../　I can do this!
Captain, I'll take it from here!
Lieutenant Hugo, I'll back you up!
Get out of there, Second Lieutenant Calvina!
Get away while you can, Akemi!
Seolla! Get out while you can!
Axel, get out of there, quick!
With this momentum, I can do it!
I've got weapons like this too!
This is really a Gunner weapon...!
Its rate of fire is no joke!
This attack comes from the Striker!
I'll pin down the enemy's movements!
I'll slam this into you at full power!
I'll draw out the frame's full potential!
I'll make use of both/　the Gunner's and the Striker's strengths!
Along with the flow of time, we'll survive!
Nothing can stop time or the Excellence!
